##  Where to Make a Big Splash 
Some of the most popular lakes in Connecticut are also the most scenic. You’ll find sprawling freshwater lakes and beautiful vistas all over the state.
![](https://ctvisit.com/themes/custom/ctvisit_bootstrap/images/Left.png)
##### [Bantam Lake, Morris ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/bantam-lake) [ ![Bantam Lake with wildflowers and wooded shoreline under blue sky](https://ctvisit.com/sites/default/files/styles/tall_330x320/public/BantamLake_Hero_1.jpg?h=082a0dbe&itok=yrEfgBSD) ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/bantam-lake)
[ Bantam Lake, Morris ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/bantam-lake)
The largest natural body of water in Connecticut, fed by the Bantam River.
##### [Lake Waramaug State Park, Washington ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/lake-waramaug-state-park) [ ![Lake Waramaug surrounded by colorful fall foliage and hills](https://ctvisit.com/sites/default/files/styles/tall_330x320/public/lake-Waramaug-fall.jpg?h=ccb31dcf&itok=JgAyKF9S) ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/lake-waramaug-state-park)
[ Lake Waramaug State Park, New Preston ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/lake-waramaug-state-park)
Relaxing spot in western Connecticut for swimming, water-skiing, kayaks, fishing and camping.
##### [Candlewood Lake Town Park, Danbury ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/candlewood-lake-town-park) [ ![Boats docked on Candlewood Lake with forested hillside and homes](https://ctvisit.com/sites/default/files/styles/tall_330x320/public/CandlewoodLake_2_0.JPG?h=28dcbfb4&itok=H8I187dh) ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/candlewood-lake-town-park)
[ Candlewood Lake, Danbury ](https://ctvisit.com/listings/candlewood-lake-town-park)
Connecticut's largest man-made reservoir, popular with boaters and watersports lovers.
